slides.body: 5 simple life lessons jo tumhari direction badal sakte hain.
Perfect time kabhi nahi aata. Start small. Start today.
Mood nahi. Routine kaam karti hai. Chhote actions repeat karo.
Har setback ek lesson hai. Note karo, seekho, fir se chalo.
Apni race run karo. Slow progress bhi progress hota hai.
Roz 1% better bano. Save, share aur action lo.

caption:
Perfect time ka wait mat karo. Chhota start bhi start hota hai.

Aaj ek small action lo. Kal ke confidence ka base aaj ka action hota hai.
